o.text: Morphologically altı + -ıncı. Cognate with Kazakh алтыншы (altınšı), Crimean Tatar altıncı, Turkish altıncı, and Turkmen altynjy.
From Proto-Turkic *kï̄yn. Cognate with Turkish kınamak, Chuvash хӗн (hĕn, “suffering”) etc.
Borrowed from Classical Persian خَجالَت (xajālat), a Pseudo-Arabism derived from the Arabic root خ ج ل (ḵ j l).
